stories.title: People showcase apps built with Claude Opus 5.5
stories.summary: Creators share an Arduino learning app, a truck-load visualiser and an HTML motion tool made with Opus 5.5.

top_posts.author: @DilumSanjaya
top_posts.text:
Hardware looks scary until you break it down into small steps. So I built an app that takes you through Arduino one circuit at a time.

Made with Opus 5.5
https://learn-arduino-red.vercel.app

top_posts.author: @OdinLovis
top_posts.text:
Motion2Code

Claude can't design motion this good on its own. So I let H3 Max on @fal design it, and fal-agent (Claude Opus 5.5) rebuilds it as one HTML file: SVG + @greensock GSAP, looping seamlessly, sharp up to 32K.

I'm open-sourcing the library that makes these animations.
